title: Watermelon
statementMd: A watermelon weighs w. Determine whether it can be split into two parts, each with a positive even weight.
outputSpecMd: Print YES if such a split is possible, otherwise print NO.

title: Theatre Square
statementMd: Cover an n × m square with the minimum number of a × a flagstones. The stones may extend beyond the square, but their sides must remain parallel to its sides and they cannot be broken.
inputSpecMd: Three integers n, m and a, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
outputSpecMd: Print the minimum number of flagstones needed.

title: N-choice question
statementMd: Given integers A and B and N distinct choices C_i, exactly one choice equals A + B. Find its 1-based index.
inputSpecMd: The first line contains N, A and B, with 1 ≤ N ≤ 300 and 1 ≤ A, B ≤ 1000. The second line contains N distinct integers C_i, with 1 ≤ C_i ≤ 2000. Exactly one equals A + B.
outputSpecMd: Print the 1-based index of the choice equal to A + B.
